Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais  (ex.: PostgreSQL, Oracle, DynamoDB). Boa comunicação, visão sistêmica e facilidade de diálogo com áreas técnicas e de negócio.  Desejável  Certificações adicionais AWS: Solutions Architect Associate  e/ou Developer Associate . Conhecimento prévio no setor de Seguros  (forte diferencial). Familiaridade com mensageria e streaming  (ex.: Kafka, SQS, SNS). Experiência com containers e orquestração  (Docker, ECS, EKS). Vivência com CI/CD, pipelines automatizadas e observabilidade . Experiência prévia como Full Stack , com maior foco em backend.  Modelo de contratação:  CLT Full + Benefícios   Benefícios TCS – Brasil:  Plano de Saúde Planos Odontológico Seguro de Vida Vale Transporte Vale Refeição/Alimentação Auxílio Creche Gympass TCS Cares – 0800 gratuito que fornece assistência psicológica (24 hrs/dia), jurídica, social e financeira aos associados Parceria com SESC Reembolso de Certificações Portal de aprendizagem gratuito da TCS – cursos online e treinamentos ao vivo Oportunidade de experiência internacional Parceria de descontos com Universidades e escolas de idiomas Bring Your Buddy – Ao indicar pessoas você se torna elegível a receber um bônus para cada contratação TCS Gems – Reconhecimento por performance Xcelerate – Plataforma de carreira com mentoria gratuita  Operamos em escala global, com diversas bases de talentos representando 156 nacionalidades, em 55 países. Na Tata Consultancy Services promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, sempre trabalhamos pela equidade. Isso se traduz em Gênero, Pessoas com Deficiência, LGBTQIA+, Religião, Raça, Diversidade de experiências e Etnia, ou seja, todas as nossas vagas são trabalhadas com esses princípios.

title: Supervisor de vendas - Shopping Aricanduva
description:

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA     Que tal entrar para o nosso #TimedeCampeões   ? Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória, é apaixonado por esporte, acredita no trabalho em equipe e está disposto a correr junto com os nossos clientes. Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória! Tem habilidade para liderar e inspirar? Esta vaga é para você! Você vai treinar e engajar a equipe, garantir um atendimento top e cuidar da gestão do estoque, levando nosso time a marcar golaços todos os dias. RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES   Você será responsável por executar e garantir a execução dos processos de venda do setor de calçados, prestando atendimento de qualidade e zelando pela satisfação do cliente, conforme nosso roteiro de atendimento. Para entrar em campo nesta posição, você precisa:  Coordenar, acompanhar, treinar e orientar a equipe na realização das tarefas, garantindo que o padrão de atendimento seja seguido, fornecendo feedback diários com relação ao atendimento e ao desempenho, visando a melhoria contínua no alcance dos resultados. Efetuar a gestão de estoque do setor, analisando o desempenho dos produtos, visando, assim, propor abertura e/ou adequação dos limites.  Realizar conferência qualitativa e quantitativa do setor, garantir que todos os produtos do setor estejam com preços marcados corretamente.  Realizar diariamente a reunião com o time e acompanhar o desempenho de acordo com as metas diárias, visando atingir os resultados propostos.  Fazer os acompanhamentos administrativos (pontos, escalas, folgas, horas extras, advertências, entre outros) com os atletas liderados, de acordo com normas e procedimentos internos. REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES ✅ ✅  Pra jogar bonito você precisa ter:  Ensino Superior em andamento completo  Experiência na área de vendas Conhecimento e vivência com gestão de times, visando engajamento e motivação  SOBRE A CENTAURO:  A Centauro é a maior empresa de artigos esportivos da América Latina. Nossa maior missão é mobilizar pessoas e transformar vidas por meio do esporte, por isso, nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória, que iniciou em 1981 e resultou em nossas mais de 220 lojas, presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil. Por aqui, cada jogada é ensaiada e nossos craques contam com técnicos, líderes de lojas e todas as ferramentas necessárias para uma visão estratégica de jogo! O clima em loja é de descontração, mas quando chega a hora da partida, cada craque veste a camisa da sua posição e joga junto dos clientes. E se você precisar de ajuda, saiba que nosso time #jogaentrosado , afinal, aqui #miramosotopo.  Muito mais que uma loja, a Centauro é um lugar de histórias escritas por vencedores. Vem fazer seu nome, vem fazer parte do nosso #TimeDeCampeões!

Localização:  · Av. Brigadeiro Faria Lima, Itaim Bibi, São Paulo/SP Sobre nós:  Somos mais de 600 colaboradores distribuídos em quatro cidades do Brasil: Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Porto Alegre e Brasília. Além disso, temos parcerias com outros escritórios no Brasil e ao redor do mundo. Desde 1972, criamos sólidos relacionamentos com empresas líderes em diversos segmentos, simplificando relações internacionais e abrindo caminhos para negócios no Brasil e do Brasil para o mundo. No Veirano celebramos as diferenças e nos comprometemos com a garantia de oportunidades para todos(as). Tendo a pluralidade e o compromisso com as pessoas como valores, reforçamos nosso compromisso com a Diversidade e com a disseminação de uma cultura inclusiva interna e externamente. Nossas oportunidades observam a Diversidade & Inclusão em todos os sentidos e encorajamos a candidatura de talentos diversos. Queremos você em nosso time. Venha fazer parte!  #TimeVeirano  #InclusiVA

Quem você é:    Você mantém uma atitude positiva e uma abordagem voltada para o futuro, apesar de circunstâncias preocupantes ou contratempos. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você conquista a confiança e o respeito das pessoas com facilidade. Você vê os erros como oportunidades para aprender.    Para este cargo, você precisará:    Graduação em Engenharia (preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica, Automação, Instrumentação ou Mecânica);   Pós-graduação/MBA em áreas correlatas (Gestão de Negócios ou Automação) é um diferencial;  3 a 5 anos de experiência em vendas técnicas ou suporte técnico de instrumentação e controle;   Experiência prática com processos industriais (óleo e gás, química, alimentos, papel e celulose, etc.);   Português fluente e Inglês intermediário a avançado (para leitura de manuais, treinamentos e comunicação com matriz);   CRM (Salesforce ou similar);   Pacote Office (Excel, PowerPoint);   Familiaridade com normas técnicas (IEC, ISA);   Conhecimento em softwares de configuração de instrumentos;   Conhecimento de analítica, indústria de papel e celulose e Biocombustível;   Local de Trabalho: Rio Grande do Sul     Nossa Cultura e compromisso com você:    Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.   Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

Carteira ativa de clientes no varejo alimentar.   Conhecimento de redes regionais, empórios e distribuidores no Sul.   Experiência com abertura de novos mercados e expansão regional. Engage in discussions to gather information, analyze the client's projects and requirements, and identify opportunities where company's solutions can add value to win the opportunities Solution Development: Once understand the client's needs, sales engineers work to develop solutions that align with the client's projects. This may involve collaborating with the technical team to design tailored solutions that address specific challenges. Provide clients with technical support as needed and relay information to our development teams for product development and update needs Proposal Creation: Create detailed proposals that outline the proposed solution and its benefits. These proposals need to address the technical aspects while also highlighting the business value for the client as well as prepare the documents according to customer requirements which may include specifications, user's manual, disposal proposal, etc., Technical Support: Provide ongoing technical support to clients, answering questions, addressing concerns, and helping with any technical issues that arise Technical Agreement Negotiations: Involve in negotiations with clients, addressing any technical concerns, clarifying expectations, and ensuring that both parties are aligned on the proposed solution to form final technical agreement Risk Assessment and Problem Solving: Identify the possible issues ahead and provide preventative solutions for the risks. Resolve the technical issues during manufacturing, delivering and commissioning until successfully hand over to customer. Generate ideas for product and service improvement and innovation based on market trends and customer inputs  Requirements and skills: Based in (or open to relocation) Sao Paulo At least 2 years work experience in local ESS market Previous work experience as an AE or SE of ESS market is advantageous Previous experience in utility or ESS developer company is advantageous Knowledge of local ESS projects development requirements is advantageous Exceptional customer service and interpersonal skills Excellent market and competitor analysis abilities Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities Superb collaboration and communication Superb logical and strategic thinking abilities Proficient in English & Portuguese

É ele quem lidera toda a operação dentro do local ou prédio. Apoia, desenvolve e executa estratégias da empresa relacionadas à operação/gestão de um imóvel, orientando os integrantes da equipe, implementando e melhorando continuamente para que o imóvel atenda e supere as metas financeiras orçadas. Para o dia a dia: - Vale Transporte ou Estacionamento próprio; - Vale Refeição FLEX no valor de R$824,00 mensal para você ter autonomia de onde e quando usar; - Ginástica Laboral para você dar aquela esticadinha e colocar a flexibilidade em dia; - Bolsa de estudos em Idiomas, Graduação, Pós Graduação e o que mais puder impulsionar a sua carreira; - Participação nos lucros paga 2x ao ano para te dar uma super força na concretização daquele sonho especial! description:

Company Introduction Next Day AI is a privately held company specializing in applying artificial intelligence (AI) engineering and creative innovation in B2 C entertainment products. Our mission is to leverage the power of Large Language Models (LLM) and generative AI (Gen AI) to create innovative consumer products that push the boundaries of entertainment and companionship. With over 35 millions+ messages per day and millions of monthly visitors, our products are revolutionizing the way people interact with AI. This is a unique opportunity to participate and make a real difference in a company actively working to shape the future of AI applications for consumers. Job Description We're looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer who can own and drive the frontend experience across our web and mobile products. We need someone who sees problems, proposes solutions, and ships them. You'll be working across a modern React (web) and React Native (mobile) codebase, building features used by millions of users every day. You'll care deeply about code quality, maintainability, and performance - and you'll champion the use of AI-assisted and agentic coding tools to move faster without sacrificing standards. You're the kind of engineer who treats AI coding assistants as a force multiplier, not a crutch, and you're always looking for ways to improve code quality and performance with these tools. This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role. You'll collaborate closely with product, design, backend engineers, and QA - but at the end of the day, you'll own your domain and be trusted to make the right calls. What You'll Do Build, ship, and maintain high-quality features across our React web application and React Native mobile app, working across the full frontend surface area. Take ownership of major frontend initiatives end-to-end - from technical design through implementation, testing, and deployment - without needing hand-holding. Write clean, well-tested, maintainable Type Script code that other engineers can confidently build on. Champion code quality standards, review PRs thoroughly, and help to raise the bar for the whole team. Actively leverage AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Git Hub Copilot, or similar) and agentic workflows to accelerate development. Advocate for and help the team adopt best practices around AI-augmented engineering. Collaborate with Product, Design, and QA to translate requirements into elegant, performant user experiences. Push back when something doesn't make sense and propose better alternatives. Improve our frontend architecture, patterns, and tooling. Identify technical debt and address it proactively - you don't wait for permission to make things better. Contribute to our shared business logic and component libraries, ensuring consistency across web and mobile platforms. Mentor and support other engineers through code reviews, pairing sessions, and knowledge sharing. Lead by example.  What We're Looking For 5+ years of professional frontend engineering experience with a strong track record of shipping production software at scale. Deep expertise in React and the modern React ecosystem (hooks, context, routing, state management). You don't just use React - you understand it. Solid experience with React Native or strong willingness to ramp up quickly. We need someone comfortable building across both web and mobile. Advanced Type Script proficiency. You write typed code by default and understand how to use the type system to prevent bugs and improve developer experience. A genuine passion for clean, maintainable code. You care about naming things well, keeping components focused, writing meaningful tests, and leaving code better than you found it. Demonstrated experience with AI-assisted development tools and a clear point of view on how to use them effectively. You're a champion of agentic coding workflows and can show how you've used them to ship faster. Self-directed and proactive. You take initiative, own your work fully, and don't need to be managed closely. You see what needs doing and do it. Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset. You can articulate technical decisions clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, startup-like environment where priorities shift and ambiguity is the norm.  Nice to have Familiarity with our tech stack: React 18, React Native, Type Script, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Redux Toolkit, Vitest, React Testing Library, Git Hub Actions, Yarn 4 Experience with real-time features (Socket. Io, Web Sockets) and streaming interfaces Experience building and consuming shared component libraries or design systems Familiarity with feature flag systems (Growth Book or similar) and progressive rollout strategies Background in B2 C consumer products with high traffic and millions of daily active users Experience with PWA architecture, service workers, and offline-first patterns Familiarity with the Atlassian suite (Jira, Confluence) Interest or experience in AI/LLM products and conversational interfaces  Why join us? Real 100% remote work (we don't have physical offices to go to "once per week") Flex-time / Manage your schedule Policy (we are looking for teamwork and results, not hours) Unlimited Vacations Policy Competitive salary and benefits package. A dynamic and supportive work environment.  If you're passionate about AI and innovation and want to be at the forefront of the conversational AI revolution and join a team on the first few years of a great journey, apply today! We might have a seat for you on our rocketship!

Shape the technical direction of features in collaboration with product and design from their earliest stages. Translate technical complexity into clear, timely communication for the team and stakeholders.  WHAT YOU'LL NEED Solid experience as a software developer, with production systems at scale. Strong background in software architecture and system design for production environments. Experience with monitoring, observability, and incident response in live systems. Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives and mentor junior engineers. Working proficiency in English.  Nice to have Experience with Unity/C# for mobile development. Experience with Go and Kubernetes-based backend systems. Experience with AWS infrastructure. Background in the gaming industry or other high-traffic consumer products.  MORE ABOUT YOU You've shipped things that live in production, and you understand what real ownership means. You make architectural decisions with confidence - and you can explain the 'why' to engineers, product, and leadership without losing the room. You raise the technical bar for the people around you, not as overhead, but as a natural consequence of how you work. You think in systems. You don't wait for the perfect spec. And when something breaks in production, you're the one people want to have already been thinking about it. ABOUT WILDLIFE Wildlife is one of the leading mobile game developers and publishers in the world. We have released more than 60 titles, reaching billions of people around the globe. Here, we create and maintain games that will excite, intrigue, and engage our players for years to come! You can find additional information about our values at this link () The Impact You'll Have at Voxy Growth brings complexity. This role exists to ensure our financial operations keep pace, reducing DSO, identifying risks early, and resolving payment issues before they escalate. What You'll Be Doing: Collections & Cash Application: • Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols. • Monitors AR aging reports and prioritizes collection efforts based on balance size, days past due, customer risk profile, and strategic account importance. • Investigates and resolves customer billing disputes by coordinating with Sales, AM/KAM, Billing, and Contract Administration teams; documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system. • Negotiates payment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved parameters; tracks compliance with agreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP& A Manager. • Applies incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, wire transfers) to open invoices in the AR sub-ledger; investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments. • Prepares and sends customer account statements, past-due notices, and collection letters per company dunning policies. • Processes customer write-offs and bad debt adjustments per approval policies; prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions. Credit Analysis & Risk Management: • Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history; recommends credit limits and payment terms. • Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk; flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior. • Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies. Reporting & Analysis: • Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review. • Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends. • Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation. • Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP& A Manager or Senior FP& A Analyst. What We're Looking For: • B. A/B. S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration; • 2+ years accounting and/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting; • Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details; • Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and someone who is eager to learn, contribute as a team member and do more and to progress in the company; • Advanced Excel skills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus; • Based anywhere in Brazil • Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish • Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus. Job Details: • Gross Salary: R$110,500/year • Working Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm (GMT-3) In addition to a rewarding job that that will directly impact how millions of students learn English, working here, you'll enjoy: • Competitive salary (base/commission/bonus/equity) • Great benefits: medical insurance, cell phone & wifi reimbursement, home office & wellness budget, team events • Remote friendly work policies • Professional development budget • Language classes w/ Voxy & Fluentify • Work with an awesome international team of super bright, creative, talented, and passionate individuals based around the world • Time Zones: ET(Eastern Time), BRT(Brasilia Time), SAMT(Samara Standard Time), Central European Time (CET) We believe in a workplace that is meant for everyone. Voxy is an equal opportunity employer. Voxy believes that a creative, engaged and diverse team can transform the market and positively impact people's lives through education. We are sure that the mission of building the most effective way to learn English is done with a plurality of ideas and points of view, which is why we work to promote Diversity, Equity and Inclusion initiatives in our company. In addition to training, benchmarking, and community partnerships, we also work in alignment with our internal DEI Committee. As a reflection of our beliefs around inclusion in the workplace, our selection process has no restrictions; our goal is to assemble a diverse team that will help us be leaders in our market. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. Se você se identifica com o nosso ethos – ser sempre humilde, estar sempre disposto e feliz – confira a vaga disponível abaixo e venha fazer parte da nossa equipe! Atuação: 100% Presencial Região de Atuação: Arujá/SP Horário de Trabalho: Segunda à quinta-feira das 07h às 17h (com 1h para refeição) e sexta-feira das 07h às 16h (com 1h para refeição) Modelo de Trabalho: CLT RESUMO DA POSIÇÃO: Será responsável por executar atividades de instalação, integração, testes e comissionamento de sistemas de automação industrial. Atuará na montagem e interligação de painéis de controle, instalação de dispositivos de campo, conexão de CLPs, remotas e IHMs, além da realização de testes funcionais, start-up de máquinas e suporte ao comissionamento elétrico e de software. O profissional atuará garantindo a correta implementação dos sistemas de automação em máquinas, equipamentos e linhas de produção industriais, assegurando conformidade com projetos elétricos, padrões técnicos, normas de segurança e requisitos de qualidade da empresa. DEVERES E RESPONSABILIDADES ESSENCIAIS: Realizar instalação e interligação de painéis elétricos e painéis de automação conforme diagramas e especificações técnicas. Efetuar passagem, identificação, organização e terminação de cabos de potência, controle e comunicação. Instalar infraestrutura elétrica: cable trays, eletrocalhas, leitos, dutos, conduítes e acessórios. Executar conexão de CLPs, remotas de I/O, IHMs, inversores de frequência, sensores, atuadores e demais dispositivos de automação. Efetuar testes de I/O (entrada e saída) e validação de sinais de campo. Realizar testes funcionais em sistemas de automação e equipamentos industriais. Executar parametrização de CLPs, inversores de frequência e dispositivos inteligentes. Realizar diagnósticos e solução de falhas elétricas e de automação. Executar ajustes e modificações em programas de CLP e interfaces HMI quando necessário. Participar de atividades de start-up de máquinas e linhas de produção. Interpretar diagramas elétricos, listas de I/O, arquiteturas de rede industrial e documentação técnica de automação. Realizar integração de sistemas de automação e comunicação industrial. Atualizar documentação técnica e registrar ajustes realizados durante testes e comissionamento (" Asbuilt"). Atuar em conjunto com a equipe de engenharia durante fases de testes, comissionamento e start-up. Cumprir padrões de qualidade, normas técnicas e requisitos de segurança (NR-10, NR-12 e normas aplicáveis). Realizar atividades de instalação e suporte técnico em campo quando necessário.  CONHECIMENTO / HABILIDADE / EDUCAÇÃO / EXPERIÊNCIA: Curso Técnico em Automação Industrial, Eletrotécnica, Mecatrônica ou áreas relacionadas. Desejável: 5 (cinco) anos de experiência prática em automação industrial, instalação de sistemas de controle ou comissionamento de equipamentos industriais, testes de sinais de campo, leitura de diagramas elétricos e integração de dispositivos de automação.  OUTROS ATRIBUTOS DESEJÁVEIS: Experiência com CLPs Siemens e/ou Rockwell / Allen-Bradley. Conhecimento em redes industriais como Profinet e Ether Net/IP. Experiência em indústria de latas de alumínio será considerada um diferencial. Experiência em automação de transportadores será considerada um diferencial. Experiência com sistemas de tratamento de biogás será considerada um diferencial.  BENEFÍCIOS Na Roeslein, investimos no sucesso e no bem-estar dos nossos colaboradores. Abaixo estão os benefícios oferecidos: Assistência médica (cobertura apartamento) e odontológica Seguro de Vida Vale refeição/alimentação (R$60,00 por dia útil) Incentivos para educação, com reembolsos para cursos de idiomas, cursos técnicos, graduações e especializações Incentivos para saúde física, com totalpass, reembolsos anuais de academia e reembolsos por corridas de ruas Programa de bônus Gratificação em viagens corporativas

Contamos com uma equipe multidisciplinar altamente qualificada e atuamos em rede com centros de pesquisa, universidades e empresas. Acreditamos na colaboração como chave para gerar valor e acelerar a inovação em saúde, com forte compromisso com a evolução biotecnológica no país. Se você quer fazer parte de um ambiente inovador, em crescimento e com propósito, venha para o Inventta ICT. Sua oportunidade de transformar conhecimentos em soluções começa aqui! Gostou? Inscreva-se e venha para nossas oportunidades! #vemserinventta O Dia a Dia Da Oportunidade: Coordenar e liderar projetos de inovação farmacêutica incremental e radical, abrangendo todas as etapas do desenvolvimento, desde a pesquisa científica, tecnológica e/ou patentária, desenvolvimento em bancada (estudos de viabilidade e screening de protótipos), até o escalonamento e a fabricação de lotes piloto. Atuar na prospecção, ideação, avaliação e priorização de projetos estratégicos de interesse do Instituto, voltados ao desenvolvimento interno e/ou em parceria com empresas, startups, hospitais, universidades e outras instituições, incluindo a estruturação de overview técnico-científico e definição de escopo. Coordenar a equipe de analistas e especialistas, fornecendo suporte ao longo de todas as etapas do desenvolvimento de inovações farmacêuticas, orientando a definição de formulações e processos para formas farmacêuticas de liberação imediata e modificada, em diferentes vias de administração. Atuar em novas tecnologias para plataformas inovadoras de desenvolvimento farmacotécnico, identificando, avaliando e propondo soluções tecnológicas inovadoras e criativas adequadas às necessidades dos projetos, incluindo a captação de fomentos para os projetos. Conduzir discussões técnicas relativas a inovações incrementais e radicais, assegurando conformidade com legislações nacionais e internacionais vigentes, bem como atuar em pesquisa translacional e no avanço dos projetos ao longo dos níveis de maturidade tecnológica (TRL – Technology Readiness Levels). Definir, monitorar e analisar indicadores de desempenho dos projetos e da área, avaliando impacto, eficiência e aderência aos objetivos estratégicos, bem como estruturar fluxos e procedimentos para viabilização das iniciativas de inovação. Garantir a adequada interface com áreas regulatória, industrial, qualidade, propriedade intelectual e demais áreas correlatas, visando ao cumprimento de prazos, escopo e requisitos regulatórios para registro junto aos órgãos competentes. Coordenar o planejamento das atividades da equipe, definindo prioridades e cronogramas de trabalho, em alinhamento e validação prévia com a Gerência da área, promovendo senso de urgência e responsabilidade pelo cumprimento de prazos. Elaborar, revisar e aprovar documentos técnicos para atendimento às Boas Práticas de Fabricação (BPF) e Desenvolvimento. Promover a cultura de inovação no Instituto, orientando pesquisadores e equipe técnica, estimulando o compartilhamento de conhecimentos e experiências profissionais. Participar de comitês, reuniões técnicas, treinamentos, congressos e seminários, representando a área, acompanhando ou substituindo a Gerência quando designado(a). Apoiar a Gerência da área nas atividades demandadas, contribuindo para a estruturação do Núcleo de Inovação Tecnológica (NIT) e para o fortalecimento do ecossistema de inovação farmacêutica.  O que esperamos que você tenha para concorrer: Ensino superior completo em Farmácia. Desejável pós-graduação ou especialização na área. Indispensável experiência de no mínimo 5 anos em Farmacotécnica/Galênico, com atuação relevante em projetos de pesquisa, desenvolvimento e/ou inovação de produtos farmacêuticos. Conhecimento atualizado em novas tecnologias, plataformas inovadoras e tendências em desenvolvimento farmacêutico, com capacidade de avaliação crítica e aplicação em projetos. Vivência em projetos de inovação e novos produtos envolvendo inovação incremental e/ou radical, com interface entre pesquisa científica, desenvolvimento tecnológico e aplicação industrial. Profissional com perfil inovador, proativo e orientado a resultados, com forte colaboração, comunicação clara e bom relacionamento interpessoal. Sólida base técnica e científica, com capacidade analítica, visão crítica e aplicação integrada de conhecimentos multidisciplinares. Organização, tomada de decisão e resolução de problemas em cenários complexos, sob pressão, com foco em qualidade, prazos e conformidade regulatória. Domínio avançado do Pacote Office, com forte habilidade na elaboração de relatórios técnicos. Inglês de nível avançado a fluente. Conhecimento das legislações vigentes pertinentes à área / função. Desejável familiaridade com Gestão de Projetos, possuir CNH e disponibilidade para viagens.  Remuneração, Pacote de Benefícios e Informações Gerais: Remuneração: compatível com o mercado. Benefícios: assistência médica extensiva aos dependentes (copart); assistência odontológica; day off aniversário; short Friday; vale alimentação; vale refeição ou restaurante no local, vale transporte; plano de previdência privada e total pass; PAE – Programa de Apoioao Empregado. Horário de Trabalho: Comercial Local – Modelo Presencial: Rodovia Raposo Tavares, km 30 e km22, Cotia/SP  Compromisso com a Diversidade e Inclusão: No Inventta Instituto de Ciência e Tecnologia, valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas. Nosso compromisso é oferecer um ambiente inclusivo e respeitoso, onde todas as pessoas tenham igualdade de oportunidades, independentemente de raça, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, deficiência, idade ou qualquer outra característica. Todos os nossos processos seletivos são pautados por critérios justos, éticos e transparentes.

title: Senior ruby on rails engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior ruby on rails engineer em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Stay Fi Stay Fi combines Io T and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable Wi Fi guest network with a custom-branded Wi Fi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business. Over the past 8 years, we've built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we're growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We're a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we're creating tools that our customers truly love. About You You're a senior full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 7+ years of professional experience building and shipping production applications. You're a product-minded engineer who takes ownership. You think beyond each task / ticket and consider the broader impact of your technical decisions on the business. You write expressive, readable, and maintainable code and hold yourself and others to a high standard through thoughtful code reviews. You have a strong command of Rails conventions but know when and how to diverge from them pragmatically. You're comfortable navigating and improving legacy codebases, not just greenfield projects. You're curious about Io T, Wi Fi, and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations. You're energized by working on a small team where your decisions carry real weight.  About the Role Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, Postgre SQL, Tailwind CSS, React and Java Script, and deploy it via Heroku, Azure and AWS. Take ownership of large, complex projects: from scoping and architecture through to delivery in close collaboration with the CTO. Identify and address performance bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses proactively. Build and maintain robust API integrations with 3rd party software providers. Lead by example in pull request culture; writing clear descriptions, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team. Contribute to engineering standards, tooling decisions, and best practices as a senior voice on the team.  Why Work at Stay Fi?You'll work directly with the CTO and CEO on mission-critical projects with real ownership and autonomy. Your experience and judgment will directly shape the technical direction of the product. You'll have an outsized impact both within our company and across the vacation rental industry in a way that's rarely possible at larger organizations. As you continue to help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate. You'll gain visibility into the full lifecycle of a sustainable, founder-led business well beyond just writing code.

title: Technical product owner
description:
Empresa está contratando Technical product owner em americana. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

ABOUT US  Syniti  , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.  Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.  Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.  Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.  THE ROLE   We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven  Technical Product Owner  to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4 HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.  What You’ll Do   Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.  Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.  UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.  Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.  Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.  Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.    WHAT IT TAKES   The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).  The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.  The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.  The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.  The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. Mackay Marine é uma empresa global de serviço eletrônicos marítimos com mais de 450 funcionários em 45 depósitos de serviços em 17 países, incluindo Américas, Europa, África e Ásia. Por mais de cinquenta (50) anos, a Mackay vendeu, instalou e atendeu equipamentos de navegação e comunicação a bordo de navios comerciais e navais, iates e embarcações de recreio. A Mackay garante o sucesso de nossos funcionários investindo em treinamento contínuo na fábrica e fornecendo todas as peças, suporte técnico e administrativo necessários. Também oferecemos salários competitivos, horas extras, benefícios e oportunidades de crescimento com base no mérito. A Mackay Marine Brasil atualmente tem vagas em nossas localidade do Paranagua Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo com experiência, habilidades e qualificações abaixo. Mackay se originou e está sediada nos EUA, é necessário ter proficiência em falar, ler e escrever em inglês.  Resumo do Trabalho de Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo:  Sob supervisão limitada, os Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo (MST) instalam, fazem manutenção e reparam equipamentos eletrônicos marítimos a bordo de navios comerciais e navais, iates e embarcações de recreio. Eles testam, ajustam e solucionam problemas de componentes, PCBs, subconjuntos e antenas, bem como carregam, atualizam e modificam o software. Os Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo utilizam seus conhecimentos de teoria e circuitos eletrônicos para resolver uma variedade de problemas técnicos, bem como para fazer uso inteligente de esquemas complexos, projetos e manuais para realizar tarefas com precisão. O ambiente de trabalho geralmente envolve carregar 20 quilos, subir escadas/mastros, trabalhar em espaços confinados e exposição ao clima.  Os candidatos devem estar legalmente autorizados a trabalhar no Brasil.

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
Empresa está contratando Landholder and reforestation delivery manager em colombo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Nature Co  Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.  Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.  We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.     Role and responsibilities   The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.  The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.  Primary roles and responsibilities include:   Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management   Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.  Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.  Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.  Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.    Eligibility, due diligence & agreements   Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).  Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation  Lead closure of contract signatures.  Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system   (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).  Reforestation delivery enablement   Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).  Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.  Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).  Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).    Stakeholder engagement and safeguards   Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).  Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.  Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.  Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.    Reporting   Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.  Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Key Responsibilities:   Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.  Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.  Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.  Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;  Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral  Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels  Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures  Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements  Net-worth monitoring;  Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.  Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.  Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters. title: Risk management officer
description:
Confira a vaga para Risk management officer em louveira. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Us  Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.  Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.  As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.  Key Responsibilities:   Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.  Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.  Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.  Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;  Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral  Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels  Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures  Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements  Net-worth monitoring;  Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.  Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.  Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.  Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.  Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.    Requirements:   Legally resident in Brazil.  Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.  Demonstrated  independence from commercial functions  and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.   Strong knowledge of  Central Bank of Brazil  risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.   Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.  Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.  Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in  Portuguese and English  .   Must meet  fit and proper  standards with  no disqualifying factors  , including:   not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;  unblemished reputation;  knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;  technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.  not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request
